scene: The tipped trumpeter hands you a brass key.
picture: Side view along a single level wooden floor. At far left stands a heavy iron door with a brass keyhole. You stand at centre left in your red poncho, moustache, and straw hat, holding a brass key. At centre, the smiling trumpeter plays his horn. At far right, spiral stairs ascend.
shown: a heavy iron door fitted with a brass lock at far left
the smiling trumpeter holding his shining trumpet ready at centre
a winding iron staircase leading up high at far right
